text:
incident-bot: ALERT: High tail latency detected for decode on prod region us-west-2. p95=480ms (↑), p99=2.8s (breach). Erroring streaming sessions observed -> tag: paging, streaming-stalls.

oncall-sre-anna: I see the alert, acknowledging. Pulling traces and recent deploys.

raj-eng-runtime: FWIW started seeing elevated tail after the TRT/FlashAttention kernel rollout last night (~02:10 UTC). We pushed new compile flags: `-DTRT_FLASHATTN=enabled -O3 -fno-math-err` to the optimized decode path.

olivia-eng-sre: Correlating now — p99 spike aligns with kernel rollout window and a surge in paging events on GPUs (nvml reports high page faults).

jen-prodops: Any customer impact yet? kev?

kevin-support: A handful of customers reported stalled streams and timeouts in the last 30m. One support ticket from acme-inc mentions partial responses stuck mid-stream. Marking severity 2 for now.

raj-eng-runtime: Dumping sample logs from a failing decode stream:
```
[2026-03-14T02:36:12Z] decode: start request id=xyz123 model=redwood-1q seq=1024
[2026-03-14T02:36:14Z] runtime: allocate KV cache -> mem margin low, triggering swap/paging
[2026-03-14T02:36:15Z] kernel: flash_attn_opt dispatch -> kernel 0x7f9 apply compile flags
[2026-03-14T02:36:16Z] decode: stall: waiting on device memory, total stall 2300ms
```

raj-eng-runtime: See the `alloc` -> `paging` -> `stall` chain. The new kernel seems to increase working set or changes memory access pattern causing NVMM thrashing.

olivia-eng-sre: I can reproduce with a synthetic trace against the canary pool. p99 jumps only when sequence lengths > 512 and with flash-attn enabled. p95 modestly affected.

oncall-sre-anna: Immediate mitigation options: 1) rollback kernel compile flags on canary + pause rollout, 2) divert traffic to non-flash-attn model variant, 3) increase GPU memory reserve (reduce concurrency), 4) enable prefix caching to reduce KV changes. Which do we want as hotfix?

raj-eng-runtime: Recommend: quick rollback of the kernel flags at the infra layer for the affected GPU pool and also route streaming traffic to fallback replica. Rollback command (k8s node pool job):
```
kubectl -n runtime rollout undo daemonset/inference-kernel --to-revision=20260313-1
# or
ansible-playbook playbooks/undo-kernel-flags.yml -e pool=prod-usw2-canary
```

jen-prodops: I'll run the rollback on canary now and pause the global rollout. deploy-bot, can you pause?

deploy-bot: Received pause request for kernel-rollout-2026-03-13. Pausing global rollout. Canary remains targeted for rollback as requested.

kevin-support: Noting: routing to fallback variant will require a short config push to the API gateway (5-10s). We can do that after rollback verification.

olivia-eng-sre: Rolling back canary now. Observability: creating temporary dashboard for p95/p99 + gpu pagefaults per node.

raj-eng-runtime: Also add a temporary nginx/edge-based canary header to route ~20% streaming traffic to fallback without touching customers. Config: `X-RW-Fallback: enable` on routing rule.

incident-bot: ACTION TAKEN: kernel-rollout paused (actor=deploy-bot), canary rollback initiated (actor=jen-prodops).

oncall-sre-anna: After rollback on two canary nodes p99 dropped from 2.8s -> 520ms. Paging counters decreased by ~78%. Looks promising.

raj-eng-runtime: We should still throttle concurrency on the larger pools until we have a root cause. Moving to msg: add audit entry and open a follow-up task to instrument kernel memory access metrics.

olivia-eng-sre: Created follow-up ticket INFRA-1287: "Investigate FlashAttention kernel memory footprint and compile flags impact on NVMM paging" assigned to raj-eng-runtime + eng-ml.

kevin-support: Customer note: Acme-inc experiencing degraded service for ~18m. Christopher from acme emailed earlier; I'll send an update: rollback performed, mitigation in place, next steps and ETA for full resolution TBD.

raj-eng-runtime: For root cause we need to reproduce with same TRT version + flags and enable device page tracing; suspect the `-fno-math-err` change allowed a different code path in the kernel that increases scratch memory. Also check cuBLAS plan changes.

jen-prodops: Next steps for now: 1) keep rollback paused on global rollout, 2) maintain fallback routing for streaming for next 4h, 3) reduce concurrency by 20% on large pools, 4) ops to monitor p99 -> if <700ms for 30m we close incident.

oncall-sre-anna: Handoff to night shift (olivia). I'm going offline in 35m. Olivia, please own until resolution or re-escalation.

olivia-eng-sre: Acknowledged, taking over. Will post hourly updates and escalate to eng-ml if we see any re-regressions.

sophia-cs: I'll draft a customer-facing summary for affected customers and coordinate with Kevin. Keep me looped for messaging.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation applied (rollback + routing). Current p95=420ms, p99=590ms, streaming errors trending down. Next update in 30m or on change.

oncall-sre-anna: Thanks team. Closing the active pager but leaving the incident open for root-cause until INFRA-1287 is resolved. :white_check_mark:
